checks.reason: Captured messages are copied unchanged and delivered through the existing Step entrypoints. The default randomness path executes the original electionTimeout + globalRand.Intn(electionTimeout) draw when the new option is unset, so no term, quorum, message, or election algorithm behavior changed.

checks.name: testing_contract_conformance

evidence.reason: Callable list entrypoint returning stable IDs plus sender, receiver, type, and capture order in a defensive copy.
Callable clear entrypoint resets both the pending store and in-flight messages.
Callable inject-by-ID entrypoint delivers through the recorded RawNode binding and consumes only the selected message.
Shipped Config option pins the randomized election timeout without replacing the election-timeout algorithm; the zero default preserves the original draw.
Opt-in async-harness capture setup declared in the interface report.

checks.reason: Exported ListPending, ClearPending, and InjectByID satisfy the message capture and injection contracts; the shipped Config.RandomizedElectionTimeout satisfies determinism without replacing the algorithm; the async harness path is covered internally; the one deliberately uncovered randomness path is explicitly declared in the interface report.

risks: InteractionEnv.Messages remains an exported mutable slice; external code that appends to or removes from it directly can desynchronize env.pending and break InjectByID's same-index removal assumption.

The Node async harness capture/injection API is internal-only: startNodeWithCapture returns an unexported *node and listPending/clearPending/injectByID are unexported, so external test packages cannot use the async-path capture/injection surface; async-path coverage is exercised only inside package rafttest.

node.injectByID removes the selected record before routing through iface.send and may silently drop the message on disconnect, dropmap match, or a full receive queue, so async-path success does not guarantee the message reached Node.Step.
ListPending returns a shallow copy of PendingMessage, so the embedded *raftpb.Snapshot pointer is shared with the store; the control layer does not mutate it, but callers could.
Config.RandomizedElectionTimeout accepts out-of-range or negative values as documented; such values can produce unusual election timing if misused by a test.
